title: Less Searching More Selling with Sales Order Agent (2025)

chapters.title: Introducing the Sales Order Agent Solution

features.name: Sales Order Agent
features.description: An AI agent that processes customer emails and suggests sales orders by intelligently matching customer requests to items in Business Central using natural language understanding and multiple search parameters.

features.name: Multi-parameter Item Search
features.description: The agent searches items using multiple parameters including description, additional description, GTN number, item category code and description, item attributes, variants, identifiers, references, extended text and translations.

features.name: Item Attributes Search
features.description: The agent searches through item attributes such as material, size, color, weight, or dimensions to help match customer requests that specify these characteristics.

features.name: Item Variants Matching
features.description: The agent searches among item variants, different versions of the same item in Business Central, such as stationary or mobile models, or variations in size, color, or style.

features.name: Item Identifiers and Alternative Codes Search
features.description: The agent searches item identifiers and alternative codes used for items, such as vendor numbers, barcodes, or customer-specific codes that uniquely identify items.

features.name: Item References Matching
features.description: The agent searches through item references, additional links in Business Central such as customer item numbers or vendor item numbers that help match the way different parties refer to the same item.

features.name: Extended Text and Translations Search
features.description: The search includes information captured in extended text and translations, ensuring that detailed descriptions or requests in different languages are analyzed to find the right item match.

features.name: Natural Language Understanding for Item Recognition
features.description: The agent uses natural language understanding to recognize and find requested items where customers use their own codes or other ways of naming items, interpret details, and match them against data.
